name: AI content workflow builder for SEO teams
demand: The seller reports 6,000 registered accounts and 5 paying customers, a rough 0.08% ratio that is not a cohort conversion rate; these figures are unverified. AirOps separately says thousands of marketers have used its product. No independently verified search-volume or install figures found. Sources: https://app.acquire.com/public/qu607egp2n-no-code-ai-content-workflow-builder-for-seo-teams-airops-alternative-working-product-6k-signups and https://www.airops.com/blog/introducing-airops-2-0-winning-content
prices: The listing says the product has $20/$75/$200 plans, but does not specify currency. Current alternatives: AirOps publicly lists Solo, Pro and Enterprise but not plan prices on its pricing page; Solo overage is $0.025/task. Jasper Pro is $69/month or $59/month billed yearly per seat, with Business custom priced. Surfer Essential is $99/month or $79/month billed yearly; Scale is $219/month or $175/month billed yearly. Writesonic lists annual-billing rates of $79/$199/$399 per month for Starter/Basic/Growth. Byword lists $99/$299/$999 per month for 25/80/300 articles. Sources: https://app.acquire.com/public/qu607egp2n-no-code-ai-content-workflow-builder-for-seo-teams-airops-alternative-working-product-6k-signups ; https://www.airops.com/pricing ; https://www.jasper.ai/pricing ; https://surferseo.com/pricing/ ; https://writesonic.com/pricing ; https://byword.ai/pricing/

revenue_proof.claim: Acquire listing reports $600 last-month revenue and $500 profit. Its connected-metrics section says fewer than 10 customers and $0 ARR, while the narrative says 5 payers. The payment records are not publicly visible, so this remains an unverified seller/listing claim.
revenue_proof.claim_event_date: September 2026 inferred from the page's 'last month' label as of 2026-10-23; exact transaction dates unverified

revenue_proof.claim: Listing reports $21.6k TTM revenue and $14k TTM profit. Its narrative also says the business is loss-making on the TTM P&L; public materials do not reconcile the discrepancy.
revenue_proof.claim_event_date: Unverified; the listing does not expose the TTM reporting endpoints

revenue_proof.claim: Seller says the product once reached about $3k MRR, then marketing stopped and revenue declined. Treat as zero-weight evidence: seller-reported historical traction with a stated decline, not independently verified payment proof.
revenue_proof.claim_event_date: Mid-2025 per seller; exact date unverified

copy_speed: Fast and evidenced: AirOps 2.0 shipped June 11, 2026 (an incumbent product expansion); Quattr launched a supervised AI landing-page workflow May 8, 2026 (adjacent); ArgSEO introduced SEO automation software May 30, 2026; GPTMelo announced an SEO/GEO workflow platform June 23, 2026 in a self-published press release. SearchFlow advertises a September 2026 launch but its current page still requests early access, so an actual launch is unverified. Sources: https://www.airops.com/blog/introducing-airops-2-0-winning-content ; https://www.quattr.com/press-release/ai-ppc-ready-landing-page-generator ; https://www.argseo.com/blog/welcome-to-argseo ; https://www.prlog.org/13153851-gptmelo-launches-seo-and-geo-workflow-platform-for-ai-search-visibility.html ; https://searchflow.app/
platform_risk: The product reportedly runs on AngularJS, Firebase, Stripe, Google Cloud and multiple model/search APIs. AngularJS support ended in January 2022. Bulk AI content also faces Google scaled-content-abuse rules when pages are generated primarily to manipulate rankings without user value. API, cloud cost, provider changes and search-policy exposure are structural risks; no exclusive distribution partner is listed. Sources: https://app.acquire.com/public/qu607egp2n-no-code-ai-content-workflow-builder-for-seo-teams-airops-alternative-working-product-6k-signups ; https://angularjs.org/ ; https://developers.google.com/search/docs/essentials/spam-policies
defensible_asset: Potential assets are the existing workflow engine, reported 30+ templates, integrations, customer personas/knowledge bases, domain/content and signup list. No unique UK dataset or exclusive rules engine is evidenced. With only 5 reported payers, meaningful customer switching costs are unproven. Source: https://app.acquire.com/public/qu607egp2n-no-code-ai-content-workflow-builder-for-seo-teams-airops-alternative-working-product-6k-signups
build_effort: No greenfield build is needed if the code and infrastructure work as described. A technical audit, deployment/security review and verification of model/API billing come first. The reported AngularJS stack is end-of-life, which raises maintenance and possible migration effort; a credible effort estimate is unverified until repo access. Seller offers 30 days of handover support. Sources: https://app.acquire.com/public/qu607egp2n-no-code-ai-content-workflow-builder-for-seo-teams-airops-alternative-working-product-6k-signups ; https://angularjs.org/
channel: Use inbound SEO/comparison pages and workflow templates, Product Hunt, opt-in trials and referrals; the listing says existing comparison content ranks and the Product Hunt listing is rated 5/5. Avoid cold email, SMS, WhatsApp and social DMs to individuals or sole traders. ICO guidance says electronic marketing to corporate subscribers does not require PECR consent, but sole traders are individual subscribers and generally need consent or a valid soft opt-in; UK GDPR still applies to personal data. Sources: https://app.acquire.com/public/qu607egp2n-no-code-ai-content-workflow-builder-for-seo-teams-airops-alternative-working-product-6k-signups ; https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/business-to-business-marketing/
owner_hours_per_week: Seller claims under 5 hours/month to run as-is, equivalent to under about 1.2 hours/week; unverified and excludes unknown growth/support workload. Source: https://app.acquire.com/public/qu607egp2n-no-code-ai-content-workflow-builder-for-seo-teams-airops-alternative-working-product-6k-signups
automation_share_pct: unverified; the listing describes automated customer workflows, not the share of business operations run by AI agents
desk_test: Free, one-day diligence test: request the existing data room and reconcile dated Stripe transactions, ChartMogul customer metrics, the monthly P&L and Google Cloud bills; also inspect GA4/Search Console query and signup data. Confirm the 5 payers, $600 monthly revenue, $0 ARR and TTM profit/loss discrepancy before considering a purchase. The listing says these records are in the data room. Source: https://app.acquire.com/public/qu607egp2n-no-code-ai-content-workflow-builder-for-seo-teams-airops-alternative-working-product-6k-signups
red_flags: The lead survives the cheap kill-check but does not yet pass the owner's hard automation constraint: agent-run share is unverified. Financials conflict within the listing ($14k TTM profit versus narrative loss-making TTM; $600 last-month revenue versus $0 ARR), and public evidence does not verify the underlying transactions. Five payers against 6,000 reported signups is weak evidence of paid demand; historical ~$3k MRR is seller-described and followed by a decline, so give it zero weight. AngularJS is end-of-life. Do not count this as meeting the <=5h/week and >=50% automation constraints until diligence verifies them. Sources: https://app.acquire.com/public/qu607egp2n-no-code-ai-content-workflow-builder-for-seo-teams-airops-alternative-working-product-6k-signups ; https://angularjs.org/
